g.text: GPT-6 Luna: names associated with Black buyers paid 1.8% less (95% CI -2.6% to -0.9%), significant after Holm

g.text: Every gap is focal group minus comparison group: a negative gap means the focal group paid less.

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a63

g.text: A gap counts only if its Holm-adjusted p < 0.05; the bar is the unadjusted 95% interval. Blue ticks: a true gap this size is flagged at least

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a63

g.text: 80% of the time (fixed before the main run).

g.text: The Claude Haiku 5.5 pilot put the spread between names at 0 (for both H1 and H2), so the detectable gap may be optimistic.

g.text: Dotted lines: equivalence margins (symmetric on log price: +3.0% pairs with -2.9%, +5.0% pairs with -4.8%).

g.text: Dollar columns translate the percent gap at the comparison group's average price paid (per $1M uses the percent only). Not separate tests.
